newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 18.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Monday:
- Thousands of Rwandan Hutu refugees returned to their home villages to find lingering problems like hunger and homelessness.
- Western diplomats fear that the death of the Croatian president will strengthen nationalists who oppose a Muslim-Croatian federation in Bosnia.
- A Russian space probe destined for Mars is falling back to Earth after failing to break out of the planet's orbit.
- The quality of life for many blacks in the United States has improved, according to some statistics.
- University presses are not publishing as many specialized monographs like doctoral dissertations because they are not deemed to be marketable.
